slide1.desc: Orbit Pix talks with your child, answers questions, helps review lessons, and supports English speaking practice as an active part of everyday learning.

slide2.desc: From preschool through secondary school, Orbit-S makes learning engaging and interactive. Its lesson mode supports teachers across subjects, while playful coding, computational thinking, and STEM activities turn learning into discovery.

slide3.desc: The NCT Learning Model analyzes how each student learns, identifies their strengths, and adapts teaching methods to create a more effective learning experience.
